title: China's AI hubs, including CXMT's home Hefei, are driving the country's GDP growth, but even in these boomtowns, little of the windfall is reaching households (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: China's AI hubs, including CXMT's home Hefei, are driving the country's GDP growth, but even in these boomtowns, little of the windfall is reaching households — In Hefei, the heart of China's memory-chip industry, factories can barely keep up with the world's appetite for AI hardware.
